title: Detetive Capi e o Mistério do Bolo Desaparecido
style: Cute 3D animated cartoon for toddlers, preschool TV show style, soft Pixar-like rendering, bright saturated candy colors, rounded chubby shapes, big expressive glossy eyes, gentle warm lighting, smooth simple animation, cheerful atmosphere. No text on screen.

characters.CAPI: CAPI: a chubby brown capybara detective, small tan detective hat, brown vest, holds a round magnifying glass, calm half-lidded eyes, gentle knowing smile.
characters.TUCA: TUCA: a cheerful female toucan baker, large glossy orange-and-yellow beak, black feathers with white chest, pink apron with cupcake pattern.
characters.ZECA: ZECA: a tiny golden lion tamarin monkey kid, fluffy orange fur, small green cap worn backwards, huge curious sparkling eyes.
characters.ANTS: ANTS: three tiny cute cartoon ants with big friendly eyes and little red helmets.

scenes.action: Establishing shot: a colorful cartoon jungle village at sunrise, round mushroom-shaped houses in pastel colors, a cute bakery with a big pink cupcake-shaped roof. Camera slowly pushes in toward the bakery window where a three-layer strawberry cake with pink frosting sits on the windowsill. Cheerful playful ukulele music, birds chirping.

Inside the cute bakery, TUCA walks to the open window carrying a tray, sees the empty windowsill, gasps dramatically, drops the tray, flaps her wings in panic and shouts in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Meu bolo! Meu bolo de morango sumiu!' Dramatic comedic zoom to her shocked face.

CAPI walks calmly down the village path holding his magnifying glass, ZECA runs excitedly around him. CAPI says slowly in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Calma, Tuca. O Detetive Capi está no caso.' ZECA jumps and says fast in Brazilian Portuguese: 'E eu sou o ajudante!' Light jazzy detective music.

In front of the bakery window, TUCA gestures dramatically at the empty windowsill and says in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Eu deixei o bolo aqui na janela... e quando voltei, puf! Sumiu!' CAPI nods slowly, inspecting the windowsill with his magnifying glass.

Close-up: CAPI's magnifying glass hovers over the ground revealing a trail of sparkling cake crumbs on the cobblestone path, magnified comically through the lens. CAPI says slowly in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Hmm... interessante! Uma trilha de migalhas.' Gentle mystery music with pizzicato strings.

ZECA picks up a bright blue feather from a bush, holds it up and shouts in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Uma pena! Foi um passarinho ladrão!' Quick cut to a tiny innocent blue hummingbird watering flowers nearby, looking confused. ZECA looks embarrassed. Comedic slide-whistle sound.

ZECA spots three ANTS marching in a line carrying tiny crumbs, points dramatically and shouts in Brazilian Portuguese: 'As formigas! Prendam elas!' The ants freeze mid-step with wide eyes, one crumb drops. Dramatic comedic orchestral sting, then silly silence.

Close-up of the three cute ANTS. The lead ant holds up her tiny hands and says in a squeaky little voice in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Nós só pegamos as migalhinhas do chão!' CAPI leans in with his magnifying glass and nods kindly. Soft sweet music.

CAPI points along the crumb trail with his magnifying glass and says thoughtfully in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Olhe, Zeca... as migalhas vão para lá. Na direção contrária ao formigueiro!' Camera follows the trail winding toward the jungle. ZECA gasps in amazement. Rising curious music.

Side tracking shot: CAPI and ZECA tiptoe along the crumb trail through the colorful jungle, past giant flowers and friendly ladybugs. ZECA whispers in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Onde será que essa trilha vai dar?' Sneaky playful tiptoe music with xylophone.

CAPI and ZECA arrive at the edge of the village square, bushes rustle, colorful balloons peek from behind a large bush. CAPI raises his paw and whispers in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Shhh... tem alguém ali!' Both lean forward slowly. Gentle suspense music building.

Wide shot of the village square: many cute jungle animals (sloth, jaguar cub, parrot, armadillo) jump from behind bushes with balloons, streamers and the strawberry cake on a table, all shouting joyfully in Brazilian Portuguese: 'SURPRESA, TUCA!' Confetti explodes, TUCA arrives in shock. Big joyful music.

TUCA, with teary happy eyes, says emotionally in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Uma festa... pra mim?!' A cute sloth hands her a party hat and says slowly in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Feliz aniversário, Tuca!' Everyone cheers. Warm heartfelt music, golden light, confetti.

Festive montage in the decorated square: TUCA blows out the candles on the strawberry cake, everyone cheers, ZECA dances with a balloon, the three ANTS happily share one big crumb at their own tiny table, CAPI eats a slice of cake smiling. Upbeat cheerful party music, no lyrics.

Final shot: CAPI steps toward the camera holding his magnifying glass, winks at the viewer and says in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Mais um mistério resolvido!' Behind him the party continues with confetti. Camera pulls back, iris-out transition closing on his smiling face. Happy ending theme.
